textIssues: The reasons are written in two different styles. Choices 1, 2 and 5 use plain form (「〜ではない」「〜正しい」「〜一致する」), while choices 3 and 4 use polite form (「〜必要です」「〜合致します」「〜対象です」「〜誤りです」). Rewrite choices 3 and 4 in plain form to match the rest.
Choice 3 ends with 「表の3欄は合致します」. This can be misread as "column 3 (Ⓒ)" or "row 3 of the table" instead of "all three columns Ⓐ, Ⓑ and Ⓒ". Change it to 「Ⓐ・Ⓑ・Ⓒの3欄とも一致する」 to match choice 5.
